# Literature Review

Throughout, we will be discussing both the U.S. House of Representatives and the Canadian House of Commons. For the sake of this paper, these can be seen as equivalent, and will be jointly referred to as the "House". Similarly, Canadian Members of Parliament (MPs) and American Congressmen will be jointly referred to as Legislators.

## Political Donation, Participation, and Theories of Representation

## American Research on Out-of-District Donations during Congressional Elections 

We focus on Congressional elections since these (1) have had the most work done on them, and (2) are the American equivalent to how the House of Commons members are elected in Canadian federal elections (disregarding the Senate, Cabinet, and PM elections). We further restricted our scope of relevant papers to those dicussing out-of-district donations during an election cycle.
